# =============================================================================
# PRINT VALUE LABELS FROM METADATA FOR ALL STUDY VARIABLES
# Ground truth directly from ttgintt4.sav metadata
# =============================================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyreadstat

df, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav("ttgintt4.sav", apply_value_formats=False)
df_sgp = df[df["CNTRY"] == "SGP"].copy()

# All variables used in the study (original names before recoding)
study_vars = [
    "T4WLOADT",
    "TT4G16A", "TT4G16B", "TT4G16C", "TT4G16D", "TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F", "TT4G16G", "TT4G16H", "TT4G16I", "TT4G16J",
    "TT4G01",
    "T4TYEXPTT",
    "T4TYEXPTS",
    "TT4G04",
    "TT4G09",
    "T4TEMPWH",
    "T4TNSCH",
    "TT4G64D",
    "TT4G64H",
    "TCHWGT", 
    "IDTEACH"
]

print("="*70)
print("VALUE LABELS FROM METADATA (meta.variable_value_labels)")
print("Ground truth from ttgintt4.sav")
print("="*70)

for var in study_vars:
    var_label   = meta.column_labels[meta.column_names.index(var)] \
                  if var in meta.column_names else "NOT FOUND"
    val_labels  = meta.variable_value_labels.get(var, {})

    print(f"\n{var}")
    print(f"  Variable label : {var_label}")

    if val_labels:
        print(f"  Value labels   :")
        for code, lbl in sorted(val_labels.items()):
            print(f"    {code} = {lbl}")
    else:
        print(f"  Value labels   : (none — continuous variable)")
        # Show range instead
        if var in df_sgp.columns:
            s = df_sgp[var]
            print(f"  Range          : {s.min():.3f} to {s.max():.3f}")
            print(f"  Mean           : {s.mean():.3f}")

# =============================================================
# DIAGNOSE: Which variables are actually rotation-restricted?
# A rotation variable should be missing for ~1,126 teachers
# =============================================================

print("Missingness rates for each variable in SGP sample (N=3355):")
print(f"{'Variable':<15} {'Missing N':>10} {'Missing %':>10}")
print("-" * 38)

for v in study_vars:
    n_missing = df_sgp[v].isna().sum()
    pct = n_missing / len(df_sgp) * 100
    flag = " ← likely rotation" if n_missing > 1000 else ""
    print(f"{v:<15} {n_missing:>10} {pct:>9.1f}%{flag}")

# =============================================================
# MCAR BALANCE CHECK
# Using only covariates available for all 3,355 teachers.
# Employment status, contract type, and experience variables
# are rotation-restricted and cannot be used here.
# Only gender, qualification, multi-school, collab_culture,
# and peer_support are available for the full sample.
# =============================================================
import statsmodels.api as sm
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

import pandas as pd
import pyreadstat

df, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav("ttgintt4.sav", apply_value_formats=False)
df_sgp = df[df["CNTRY"] == "SGP"].copy()

rotation_vars = [
    "T4WLOADT",
    "TT4G16A","TT4G16B","TT4G16C","TT4G16D","TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F","TT4G16G","TT4G16H","TT4G16I","TT4G16J"
]

df_sgp["received_form"] = (~df_sgp[rotation_vars].isna().all(axis=1)).astype(int)

print(f"Received rotation form : {df_sgp['received_form'].sum()}")
print(f"Did not receive form   : {(df_sgp['received_form'] == 0).sum()}")

df_sgp["gender_r"]  = df_sgp["TT4G01"].map({1.0: 1, 2.0: 0})
df_sgp["qual_r"]    = df_sgp["TT4G04"].map({1.0:0, 2.0:0, 3.0:1, 4.0:1, 5.0:1})
df_sgp["multi_r"]   = df_sgp["T4TNSCH"].map({0.0:0, 1.0:1, 2.0:1})
df_sgp["collab_r"]  = df_sgp["TT4G64D"].map({1.0:0, 2.0:0, 3.0:1, 4.0:1})
df_sgp["peer_r"]    = df_sgp["TT4G64H"].map({1.0:0, 2.0:0, 3.0:1, 4.0:1})

balance_vars = ["received_form","gender_r","qual_r","multi_r","collab_r","peer_r"]
df_balance = df_sgp[balance_vars].dropna()
print(f"\nN for balance check: {len(df_balance)}")

X = sm.add_constant(df_balance[["gender_r","qual_r","multi_r","collab_r","peer_r"]])
y = df_balance["received_form"]

result = sm.Logit(y, X).fit()
print(result.summary())

lr_stat = result.llr
lr_df   = result.df_model
lr_p    = result.llr_pvalue

print(f"\nLikelihood Ratio Test (joint significance):")
print(f"  LR statistic : {lr_stat:.3f}")
print(f"  df           : {int(lr_df)}")
print(f"  p-value      : {lr_p:.4f}")

if lr_p > 0.10:
    print("  Result: MCAR supported — covariates do not predict rotation receipt.")
else:
    print("  Result: WARNING — covariates predict rotation receipt. Review.")

print("\nIndividual covariate p-values:")
for var in ["gender_r","qual_r","multi_r","collab_r","peer_r"]:
    coef = result.params[var]
    pval = result.pvalues[var]
    print(f"  {var:<12} coef={coef:+.3f}  p={pval:.4f}")

import pandas as pd
import pyreadstat

df, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav("ttgintt4.sav", apply_value_formats=False)
df_sgp = df[df["CNTRY"] == "SGP"].copy()

rotation_vars = [
    "T4WLOADT",
    "TT4G16A","TT4G16B","TT4G16C","TT4G16D","TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F","TT4G16G","TT4G16H","TT4G16I","TT4G16J"
]
rotation_absent = df_sgp[rotation_vars].isna().all(axis=1)
assert rotation_absent.sum() == 1126, "Wrong rotation_absent — re-run Cell 3 first"

df_received = df_sgp[~rotation_absent].copy()

ANALYSIS_VARS = [
    "T4WLOADT",
    "TT4G16A","TT4G16B","TT4G16C","TT4G16D","TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F","TT4G16G","TT4G16H","TT4G16I","TT4G16J",
    "TT4G01","T4TYEXPTT","T4TYEXPTS","TT4G04",
    "TT4G09","T4TEMPWH","T4TNSCH","TT4G64D","TT4G64H"
]

df_complete = df_received.dropna(subset=ANALYSIS_VARS)

print(f"Received form             : {len(df_received)}")
print(f"Complete on all vars      : {len(df_complete)}")
print(f"Item non-response dropped : {len(df_received) - len(df_complete)}")

Received form             : 2229
Complete on all vars      : 1768
Item non-response dropped : 461

n_total        = len(df_sgp)
n_absent       = rotation_absent.sum()
n_item_nr      = len(df_received) - len(df_complete)
n_after_listwise = len(df_complete)

total_hours = df_complete[[
    "TT4G16A","TT4G16B","TT4G16C","TT4G16D","TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F","TT4G16G","TT4G16H","TT4G16I","TT4G16J"
]].sum(axis=1)

df_final = df_complete[total_hours <= 84].copy()
n_84_excluded = len(df_complete) - len(df_final)

print("=" * 55)
print(f"{'Step':<35} {'Dropped':>8} {'Remaining':>10}")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"{'Full SGP sample':<35} {'':>8} {n_total:>10,}")
print(f"{'Rotation form not administered':<35} {n_absent:>8,} {n_total - n_absent:>10,}")
print(f"{'Item non-response (within form)':<35} {n_item_nr:>8,} {n_after_listwise:>10,}")
print(f"{'84-hour exclusion':<35} {n_84_excluded:>8,} {len(df_final):>10,}")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"{'Final analysis sample':<35} {'':>8} {len(df_final):>10,}")

# Apply 84h total non-teaching hours exclusion
# Creates df_clean from df_complete (Cell 5) and saves talis2024_sgp_final.csv
# =============================================================================
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

try:
    df_complete
    print("df_complete found in memory — proceeding.")

    # Keep IDTEACH for merging later
    df_clean = df_complete[ANALYSIS_VARS + ["TCHWGT", "IDSCHOOL", "IDTEACH"]].copy()

    df_clean["total_nonteaching"] = df_clean[
        ["TT4G16A","TT4G16B","TT4G16C","TT4G16D","TT4G16E",
         "TT4G16F","TT4G16G","TT4G16H","TT4G16I","TT4G16J"]
    ].sum(axis=1)

    n_before = len(df_clean)
    df_clean = df_clean[df_clean["total_nonteaching"] <= 84].copy()
    n_after  = len(df_clean)

    print(f"Before exclusion : {n_before}")
    print(f"After exclusion  : {n_after}")
    print(f"Dropped          : {n_before - n_after} teachers "
          f"({(n_before - n_after)/n_before*100:.1f}%)")

    df_clean.to_csv("talis2024_sgp_final.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved: talis2024_sgp_final.csv  |  N = {n_after}")
    print(f"IDTEACH included: {'IDTEACH' in df_clean.columns}")

except NameError:
    print("df_complete not in memory — run Cell 5 first.")
    raise

%matplotlib inline
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, Border, Side, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

# =============================================================
# LOAD DATA — final analysis sample (N = 1,706)
# =============================================================
df = pd.read_csv("talis2024_sgp_final.csv")
print(f"Loaded: talis2024_sgp_final.csv  |  N = {len(df):,}")

# =============================================================
# VARIABLES — 10 non-teaching IVs (teaching hours excluded)
# =============================================================
task_vars = {
    "TT4G16A": "Planning",
    "TT4G16B": "Teamwork with colleagues",
    "TT4G16C": "Marking",
    "TT4G16D": "Student counselling",
    "TT4G16E": "School management",
    "TT4G16F": "General administration",
    "TT4G16G": "Professional Development",
    "TT4G16H": "Parent Communication",
    "TT4G16I": "CCA",
    "TT4G16J": "Other tasks",
}
outcome_var = {"T4WLOADT": "Workload stress"}

# =============================================================
# WEIGHTED STATS FUNCTION
# =============================================================
def weighted_stats(df, var, weight_col="TCHWGT"):
    tmp = df[[var, weight_col]].dropna()
    if tmp.empty:
        return None
    x = tmp[var].values
    w = tmp[weight_col].values
    n = len(x)

    wmean = np.average(x, weights=w)
    wsd   = np.sqrt(np.average((x - wmean) ** 2, weights=w))

    df_s = pd.DataFrame({"x": x, "w": w}).sort_values("x")
    cumw = np.cumsum(df_s["w"]) / df_s["w"].sum()
    p25  = np.interp(0.25, cumw, df_s["x"])
    p50  = np.interp(0.50, cumw, df_s["x"])
    p75  = np.interp(0.75, cumw, df_s["x"])
    p95  = np.interp(0.95, cumw, df_s["x"])

    zeros     = int((x == 0).sum())
    zeros_pct = zeros / n * 100

    return {
        "mean": wmean, "sd": wsd,
        "p25": p25, "p50": p50, "p75": p75, "p95": p95,
        "zeros": zeros, "zeros_pct": zeros_pct, "n": n
    }

# =============================================================
# BUILD DATA ROWS
# =============================================================
rows = []

for var, label in task_vars.items():
    s = weighted_stats(df, var)
    if s is None:
        continue
    rows.append({
        "Variable": label,
        "Mean": round(s["mean"], 1),
        "SD":   round(s["sd"],   1),
        "p25":  round(s["p25"],  1),
        "p50":  round(s["p50"],  1),
        "p75":  round(s["p75"],  1),
        "p95":  round(s["p95"],  1),
        "Zeros (%)": f"{s['zeros_pct']:.1f}",
        "N":    f"{s['n']:,}",
        "_section": "task"
    })

for var, label in outcome_var.items():
    s = weighted_stats(df, var)
    if s is None:
        continue
    rows.append({
        "Variable": label,
        "Mean": round(s["mean"], 2),
        "SD":   round(s["sd"],   2),
        "p25":  round(s["p25"],  1),
        "p50":  round(s["p50"],  1),
        "p75":  round(s["p75"],  1),
        "p95":  round(s["p95"],  1),
        "Zeros (%)": "—",
        "N":    f"{s['n']:,}",
        "_section": "outcome"
    })

# =============================================================
# BUILD EXCEL FILE
# =============================================================
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Table 1"

def thin():  return Side(style="thin",   color="000000")
def thick(): return Side(style="medium", color="000000")

top_thick        = Border(top=thick())
top_thin         = Border(top=thin())
bottom_thick     = Border(bottom=thick())
top_bottom_thick = Border(top=thick(), bottom=thick())

header_font  = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=11, bold=True)
body_font    = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=11)
section_font = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=11, italic=True)
title_font   = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=12, bold=True)
center_align = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
left_align   = Alignment(horizontal="left",   vertical="center")

cols       = ["Variable", "Mean", "SD", "p25", "p50", "p75", "p95", "Zeros (%)", "N"]
col_widths = [26, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 10, 8]

# Title
ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 30
ws.merge_cells("A1:I1")
c = ws["A1"]
c.value     = ("Table 1. Weighted descriptive statistics — non-teaching task-hour variables "
               "and workload stress, Singapore TALIS 2024")
c.font      = title_font
c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)

# Blank spacer
ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 4

# Column headers
ws.row_dimensions[3].height = 16
for col_i, (col_name, width) in enumerate(zip(cols, col_widths), start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=3, column=col_i, value=col_name)
    cell.font      = header_font
    cell.alignment = center_align if col_i > 1 else left_align
    cell.border    = top_bottom_thick
    ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(col_i)].width = width

# Section A header
ws.row_dimensions[4].height = 14
ws.merge_cells("A4:I4")
sh = ws["A4"]
sh.value     = "A. Non-teaching task-hour variables (hours per week)"
sh.font      = section_font
sh.alignment = left_align
sh.border    = top_thin

# Data rows
current_row = 5

for row_data in rows:
    is_outcome = row_data["_section"] == "outcome"

    if is_outcome:
        ws.row_dimensions[current_row].height = 6
        current_row += 1
        ws.row_dimensions[current_row].height = 14
        ws.merge_cells(f"A{current_row}:I{current_row}")
        sh2 = ws.cell(row=current_row, column=1, value="B. Outcome variable")
        sh2.font      = section_font
        sh2.alignment = left_align
        sh2.border    = top_thin
        current_row  += 1

    ws.row_dimensions[current_row].height = 14
    for col_i, col_name in enumerate(cols, start=1):
        val  = row_data.get(col_name, "")
        cell = ws.cell(row=current_row, column=col_i, value=val)
        cell.font      = body_font
        cell.alignment = left_align if col_i == 1 else center_align

    if is_outcome:
        for col_i in range(1, 10):
            ws.cell(row=current_row, column=col_i).border = bottom_thick

    current_row += 1

# Notes
current_row += 1
notes = [
    ("Notes:", True),
    (f"Analysis sample: N = {len(df):,} Singapore teachers after 84-hour total non-teaching hours exclusion, weighted by TCHWGT.", False),
    ("Mean, SD, and percentiles are survey-weighted; hour variables were recorded in whole hours.", False),
    ("Zeros (%) is the unweighted share of valid observations equal to zero; — = not applicable.", False),
    ("Workload stress (T4WLOADT) is standardised to mean = 10.0, SD = 2.0 internationally (OECD, 2025).", False),
    ("Variable codes: TT4G16A (Planning), TT4G16B (Teamwork), TT4G16C (Marking), TT4G16D (Counselling),", False),
    ("TT4G16E (School management), TT4G16F (Administration), TT4G16G (Professional development), TT4G16H (Parent communication), TT4G16I (CCA), TT4G16J (Other).", False),
]

for line, bold in notes:
    ws.row_dimensions[current_row].height = 13
    ws.merge_cells(f"A{current_row}:I{current_row}")
    cell = ws.cell(row=current_row, column=1, value=line)
    cell.font      = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=10, bold=bold)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    current_row += 1

wb.save("Table1_descriptive.xlsx")
print("Saved → Table1_descriptive.xlsx")

# =============================================================
# CONSOLE PREVIEW
# =============================================================
print()
print("TABLE 1 PREVIEW")
print(f"{'Variable':<26} {'Mean':>6} {'SD':>6} {'p25':>5} {'p50':>5} {'p75':>5} {'p95':>5} {'Zeros%':>7} {'N':>6}")
print("-" * 82)
print("  A. Non-teaching task-hour variables (hours per week)")
for r in rows:
    if r["_section"] == "task":
        print(f"  {r['Variable']:<24} {r['Mean']:>6} {r['SD']:>6} "
              f"{r['p25']:>5} {r['p50']:>5} {r['p75']:>5} {r['p95']:>5} "
              f"{r['Zeros (%)']:>7} {r['N']:>6}")
print()
print("  B. Outcome variable")
for r in rows:
    if r["_section"] == "outcome":
        print(f"  {r['Variable']:<24} {r['Mean']:>6} {r['SD']:>6} "
              f"{r['p25']:>5} {r['p50']:>5} {r['p75']:>5} {r['p95']:>5} "
              f"{r['Zeros (%)']:>7} {r['N']:>6}")

# =============================================================
# FIGURE: Total non-teaching hours histogram
# =============================================================
task_cols = list(task_vars.keys())
df["total_nonteaching_10"] = df[task_cols].sum(axis=1, min_count=1)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
ax.hist(df["total_nonteaching_10"].dropna(), bins=40,
        color="steelblue", edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)
ax.axvline(84, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5,
           label="84h exclusion threshold")

median_val = df["total_nonteaching_10"].median()

ax.set_xlabel("Total weekly non-teaching hours (sum of 10 task variables)")

# =============================================================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(20, 8))
axes = axes.flatten()

for i, (var, label) in enumerate(task_vars.items()):

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# =============================================================
# STEP 1 — LOAD ORIGINAL FILE
# =============================================================
df = pd.read_csv("talis2024_sgp_final.csv")
print(f"Loaded: talis2024_sgp_final.csv  |  N = {len(df):,}")

# =============================================================
# STEP 2 — RENAME COLUMNS
# Raw source columns renamed with _raw suffix for clarity
# Already-recoded columns (female, alt_route, etc.) dropped —
# we recode fresh from raw source columns in Step 3
# =============================================================
rename_map = {
    # Dependent variable
    "T4WLOADT":          "workload_stress_scale",
    # IVs — 10 non-teaching task-hour variables
    "TT4G16A":           "hrs_lesson_planning",
    "TT4G16B":           "hrs_teamwork_collaboration",
    "TT4G16C":           "hrs_marking_correcting",
    "TT4G16D":           "hrs_student_counselling",
    "TT4G16E":           "hrs_school_management",
    "TT4G16F":           "hrs_general_admin",
    "TT4G16G":           "hrs_professional_development",
    "TT4G16H":           "hrs_parent_communication",
    "TT4G16I":           "hrs_cca_extracurricular",
    "TT4G16J":           "hrs_other_tasks",
    # Raw source columns — kept for traceability
    "TT4G01":            "gender_raw",
    "TT4G04":            "qualification_raw",
    "TT4G09":            "employment_status_raw",
    "T4TEMPWH":          "employment_hours_raw",
    "TT4G64D":           "collab_culture_raw",
    "TT4G64H":           "peer_support_raw",
    # Controls — ordinal, used as-is
    "T4TYEXPTT":         "teaching_exp_total",
    "T4TYEXPTS":         "teaching_exp_current_school",
    "T4TNSCH":           "num_schools_raw",
    # Survey admin
    "TCHWGT":            "sampling_weight",
    "IDSCHOOL":          "school_id",
    "IDTEACH":            "teacher_id",
    # Diagnostic
    "total_nonteaching": "total_nonteaching_hrs",
}

df.rename(columns=rename_map, inplace=True)

# Drop old pre-recoded columns — we recode fresh from raw below
cols_to_drop = ["female", "alt_route", "permanent", "fulltime",
                "collab_culture", "peer_support"]
df.drop(columns=[c for c in cols_to_drop if c in df.columns], inplace=True)

# =============================================================
# STEP 3 — RECODE BINARY VARIABLES FROM RAW SOURCE COLUMNS
# Based on TALIS 2024 codebook (ttgintt4.sav metadata)
# 8, 9 = Not administered / Omitted → already NaN
# =============================================================

# gender (from gender_raw / TT4G01)
# 1 = Female → 1 | 2 = Male → 0 | 3 = country-specific → NaN
df["gender"] = df["gender_raw"].map({1.0: 1, 2.0: 0, 3.0: np.nan})

# teacher_qualification (from qualification_raw / TT4G04)
# 1,2 = Regular ITE/PGDE → 0 | 3,4,5 = Not regular → 1
df["teacher_qualification"] = df["qualification_raw"].map({
    1.0: 0, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 1, 4.0: 1, 5.0: 1
})

# contract_type (from employment_status_raw / TT4G09)
# 1 = Permanent → 1 | 2,3 = Fixed-term → 0
df["contract_type"] = df["employment_status_raw"].map({
    1.0: 1, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 0
})

# employment_hours (from employment_hours_raw / T4TEMPWH)
# 1 = Full-time → 1 | 2 = Part-time → 0
df["employment_hours"] = df["employment_hours_raw"].map({1.0: 1, 2.0: 0})

# multi_school (from num_schools_raw / T4TNSCH)
# 0 = Not working in other schools → 0 | 1,2 = Working → 1
df["multi_school"] = df["num_schools_raw"].map({0.0: 0, 1.0: 1, 2.0: 1})

# collab_culture (from collab_culture_raw / TT4G64D)
# 1,2 = Disagree/Strongly disagree → 0 | 3,4 = Agree/Strongly agree → 1
df["collab_culture"] = df["collab_culture_raw"].map({
    1.0: 0, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 1, 4.0: 1
})

# peer_support (from peer_support_raw / TT4G64H)
# 1,2 = Disagree/Strongly disagree → 0 | 3,4 = Agree/Strongly agree → 1
df["peer_support"] = df["peer_support_raw"].map({
    1.0: 0, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 1, 4.0: 1
})

df["teacher_id"] = df["teacher_id"].replace([999998.0, 999999.0], np.nan)
print("teacher_id missing after replacement:", df["teacher_id"].isna().sum())

# Drop raw source columns — recoded versions are ready
raw_cols = [
    "gender_raw", "qualification_raw", "employment_status_raw",
    "employment_hours_raw", "num_schools_raw",
    "collab_culture_raw", "peer_support_raw"
]
df.drop(columns=raw_cols, inplace=True)

# =============================================================
# STEP 4 — VERIFICATION
# =============================================================
print()
print("=" * 65)
print("RECODE VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 65)

checks = {
    "gender": {
        "source": "gender_raw (TT4G01) — Background / Gender",
        1: "Female",
        0: "Male",

%matplotlib inline
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, Border, Side, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

# =============================================================
# LOAD DATA — run prepare_data.py first
# =============================================================
df = pd.read_csv("talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv")
print(f"Loaded: talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv  |  N = {len(df):,}")

# =============================================================
# VARIABLE ORDER AND LABELS
# =============================================================
var_info = {
    "workload_stress_scale":        "Workload stress (DV)",
    "hrs_lesson_planning":          "Lesson Planning",
    "hrs_teamwork_collaboration":   "Teamwork with colleagues",
    "hrs_marking_correcting":       "Marking",
    "hrs_student_counselling":      "Student Counselling",
    "hrs_school_management":        "School management",
    "hrs_general_admin":            "General Administration",
    "hrs_professional_development": "Professional Development",
    "hrs_parent_communication":     "Parent Communication",
    "hrs_cca_extracurricular":      "CCA",
    "hrs_other_tasks":              "Other tasks",
    "gender":                       "Gender",
    "teaching_exp_total":           "Experience (total)",
    "teaching_exp_current_school":  "Experience (current school)",
    "teacher_qualification":        "Teacher qualification",
    "contract_type":                "Contract type",
    "employment_hours":             "Employment hours",
    "multi_school":                 "Number of schools",
    "collab_culture":               "Collaborative culture",
    "peer_support":                 "Peer support",
}

vars_present = [v for v in var_info.keys() if v in df.columns]
labels       = [var_info[v] for v in vars_present]
n_vars       = len(vars_present)
print(f"Variables in matrix: {n_vars}")

missing = [v for v in var_info.keys() if v not in df.columns]
if missing:
    print(f"WARNING — not found in dataset: {missing}")

# =============================================================
# WEIGHTED PEARSON CORRELATION FUNCTION
# =============================================================
def weighted_corr(x, y, w):
    w  = w / w.sum()
    mx = np.sum(w * x)
    my = np.sum(w * y)
    cov = np.sum(w * (x - mx) * (y - my))
    sx  = np.sqrt(np.sum(w * (x - mx) ** 2))
    sy  = np.sqrt(np.sum(w * (y - my) ** 2))
    if sx == 0 or sy == 0:
        return np.nan
    return cov / (sx * sy)

# =============================================================
# BUILD CORRELATION MATRIX
# =============================================================
weights = df["sampling_weight"].values
data    = df[vars_present].values

corr_matrix = np.zeros((n_vars, n_vars))
for i in range(n_vars):
    for j in range(n_vars):
        corr_matrix[i, j] = weighted_corr(data[:, i], data[:, j], weights)

print("Correlation matrix computed (weighted Pearson).")

# =============================================================
# SECTION ASSIGNMENT
# =============================================================
section_map = {}
for v in vars_present:
    if v == "workload_stress_scale":
        section_map[v] = "DV"
    elif v in ["hrs_lesson_planning","hrs_teamwork_collaboration",
               "hrs_marking_correcting","hrs_student_counselling",
               "hrs_school_management","hrs_general_admin",
               "hrs_professional_development","hrs_parent_communication",
               "hrs_cca_extracurricular","hrs_other_tasks"]:
        section_map[v] = "IV"
    elif v in ["gender","teaching_exp_total","teaching_exp_current_school",
               "teacher_qualification","contract_type",
               "employment_hours","multi_school"]:
        section_map[v] = "Control"
    elif v in ["collab_culture","peer_support"]:
        section_map[v] = "Resource"

# =============================================================
# FIGURE: HEATMAP
# =============================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 18))   # wider + taller

im = ax.imshow(corr_matrix, cmap=plt.cm.RdBu_r, vmin=-1, vmax=1, aspect="auto")

cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.03, pad=0.02)
cbar.set_label("Weighted Pearson r", fontsize=16)
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=14)                 
ax.set_xticks(range(n_vars))
ax.set_yticks(range(n_vars))
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=20)
ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=20)

# Cell numbers — bigger font
for i in range(n_vars):
    for j in range(n_vars):
        r = corr_matrix[i, j]
        text_color = "white" if abs(r) > 0.55 else "black"
        ax.text(j, i, f"{r:.2f}", ha="center", va="center",
        fontsize=13, color=text_color)

# Section divider lines
for pos in [0.5, 10.5, 17.5]:
    ax.axhline(pos, color="black", linewidth=1.5)
    ax.axvline(pos, color="black", linewidth=1.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_correlation_heatmap.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_correlation_heatmap.png")

# =============================================================
# EXCEL TABLE — PUBLICATION FORMAT
# =============================================================
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Correlation Matrix"

def thick(): return Side(style="medium", color="000000")

top_bottom_thick = Border(top=thick(), bottom=thick())
bottom_thick_b   = Border(bottom=thick())

title_font   = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=13, bold=True)
header_font  = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=12, bold=True)
body_font    = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=12)
section_font = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=12, italic=True)   # FIXED: was 112
center_align = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
left_align   = Alignment(horizontal="left",   vertical="center", wrap_text=True)

def get_fill(r_val):
    if np.isnan(r_val):
        return PatternFill()
    if r_val >= 0:
        intensity = min(int(r_val * 180), 180)
        hex_color = f"{255:02X}{255-intensity:02X}{255-intensity:02X}"
    else:
        intensity = min(int(abs(r_val) * 180), 180)
        hex_color = f"{255-intensity:02X}{255-intensity:02X}{255:02X}"
    return PatternFill("solid", start_color=hex_color, fgColor=hex_color)

ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 30
ws.merge_cells(f"A1:{get_column_letter(n_vars + 2)}1")
tc = ws["A1"]
tc.value     = ("Table 2. Weighted Pearson correlation heatmap, "
                "Singapore TALIS 2024 (N = 1,706)")
tc.font      = title_font
tc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)

ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 4

ws.row_dimensions[3].height = 80
ws.cell(row=3, column=1, value="Variable").font      = header_font
ws.cell(row=3, column=1).alignment = left_align
ws.cell(row=3, column=1).border    = top_bottom_thick
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width    = 26

ws.cell(row=3, column=2, value="Section").font      = header_font
ws.cell(row=3, column=2).alignment = center_align
ws.cell(row=3, column=2).border    = top_bottom_thick
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width    = 10

for j, lbl in enumerate(labels, start=3):
    cell = ws.cell(row=3, column=j, value=lbl)
    cell.font      = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="bottom",
                               wrap_text=True, text_rotation=90)
    cell.border    = top_bottom_thick
    ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(j)].width = 6

current_row = 4
for i, (var, lbl) in enumerate(zip(vars_present, labels)):
    ws.row_dimensions[current_row].height = 14
    ws.cell(row=current_row, column=1, value=lbl).font      = body_font
    ws.cell(row=current_row, column=1).alignment = left_align
    ws.cell(row=current_row, column=2,
            value=section_map.get(var, "")).font      = section_font
    ws.cell(row=current_row, column=2).alignment = center_align

    for j in range(n_vars):
        r_val   = corr_matrix[i, j]
        col_j   = j + 3
        display = "1.00" if i == j else f"{r_val:.2f}"
        cell    = ws.cell(row=current_row, column=col_j, value=display)
        cell.font      = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=12,
                              bold=(i == 0 or j == 0))
        cell.alignment = center_align
        cell.fill      = get_fill(r_val)

    if i == n_vars - 1:
        for col_j in range(1, n_vars + 3):
            ws.cell(row=current_row, column=col_j).border = bottom_thick_b

    current_row += 1

current_row += 1
notes = [
    ("Notes:", True),
    ("Weighted Pearson correlations using sampling weights (TCHWGT). N = 1,706 Singapore teachers, TALIS 2024.", False),
    ("DV = dependent variable; IV = non-teaching task-hour independent variables; Control = individual-level controls; Resource = job resource controls.", False),
    ("Bold values indicate correlations involving the dependent variable. Diagonal = 1.00 by definition.", False),
    ("Colour intensity reflects the magnitude of r: deeper red = stronger positive association; deeper blue = stronger negative association.", False),
]
for line, bold in notes:
    ws.row_dimensions[current_row].height = 13
    ws.merge_cells(f"A{current_row}:{get_column_letter(n_vars + 2)}{current_row}")
    cell = ws.cell(row=current_row, column=1, value=line)
    cell.font      = Font(name="Times New Roman", size=12, bold=bold)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    current_row += 1

wb.save("Table2_correlation_matrix.xlsx")
print("Saved: Table2_correlation_matrix.xlsx")

# =============================================================
# CONSOLE — DV correlations ranked by magnitude
# =============================================================
print()
print("=" * 55)
print("CORRELATIONS WITH WORKLOAD STRESS")
print("=" * 55)
dv_idx = vars_present.index("workload_stress_scale")
corr_with_dv = [(labels[i], corr_matrix[dv_idx, i])
                for i in range(n_vars) if i != dv_idx]
corr_with_dv.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
print(f"  {'Variable':<30} {'r':>7}")
print("  " + "-" * 38)
for lbl, r in corr_with_dv:
    print(f"  {lbl:<30} {r:>+7.3f}")

# =============================================================
# FIGURES
# =============================================================
%matplotlib inline
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv")
print(f"Loaded: N = {len(df):,}")

# Weighted correlation helper
def w_corr(x, y, w):
    w = w / w.sum()
    mx, my = np.sum(w*x), np.sum(w*y)
    cov = np.sum(w*(x-mx)*(y-my))
    sx = np.sqrt(np.sum(w*(x-mx)**2))
    sy = np.sqrt(np.sum(w*(y-my)**2))
    return np.nan if sx==0 or sy==0 else cov/(sx*sy)

w = df["sampling_weight"].values

task_cols = {
    "hrs_lesson_planning":          "Planning",
    "hrs_teamwork_collaboration":   "Teamwork",
    "hrs_marking_correcting":       "Marking",
    "hrs_student_counselling":      "Counselling",
    "hrs_school_management":        "School mgmt",
    "hrs_general_admin":            "Administration",
    "hrs_professional_development": "Professional development",
    "hrs_parent_communication":     "Parent communication",
    "hrs_cca_extracurricular":      "CCA",
    "hrs_other_tasks":              "Other tasks",
}
dv = "workload_stress_scale"

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Correlation bar chart ranked by magnitude
# -----------------------------------------------------------
corrs = {}
for col, lbl in task_cols.items():
    tmp = df[[col, dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
    corrs[lbl] = w_corr(tmp[col].values, tmp[dv].values, tmp["sampling_weight"].values)

corrs_sorted = dict(sorted(corrs.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
labels = list(corrs_sorted.keys())
values = list(corrs_sorted.values())
colors = ["#c0392b" if v > 0 else "#2980b9" for v in values]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
bars = ax.barh(labels[::-1], values[::-1], color=colors[::-1])
ax.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
for bar, val in zip(bars, values[::-1]):
    ax.text(val + (0.003 if val >= 0 else -0.003), bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f"{val:+.2f}", va="center", ha="left" if val >= 0 else "right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Weighted Pearson r with workload stress")
ax.set_xlim(-0.20, 0.28)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_correlation_bars.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_correlation_bars.png")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Weighted mean stress by marking hours quartile
# -----------------------------------------------------------
tmp = df[["hrs_marking_correcting", dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
tmp["quartile"] = pd.qcut(tmp["hrs_marking_correcting"], q=4,
                          labels=["Q1\n(0–3h)", "Q2\n(4–5h)", "Q3\n(6–8h)", "Q4\n(9–15h)"])

q_means = tmp.groupby("quartile", observed=True).apply(
    lambda g: np.average(g[dv], weights=g["sampling_weight"])
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
bars = ax.bar(q_means.index.astype(str), q_means.values, color="steelblue", edgecolor="white")
ax.axhline(np.average(tmp[dv], weights=tmp["sampling_weight"]),
           color="darkred", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5,
           label=f"Overall weighted mean (9.77)")
ax.axhline(10, color="navy", linestyle=":", linewidth=1.2, label="International mean (10.0)")
for bar, val in zip(bars, q_means.values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, val + 0.02, f"{val:.2f}",
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Marking hours quartile (hours/week)")
ax.set_ylabel("Weighted mean workload stress (T4WLOADT)")
ax.legend()
ax.set_ylim(9.0, 10.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_marking_quartile.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_marking_quartile.png")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Weighted mean stress by CCA hours quartile
# -----------------------------------------------------------
tmp = df[["hrs_cca_extracurricular", dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
tmp["quartile"] = pd.qcut(tmp["hrs_cca_extracurricular"], q=4, duplicates="drop",
                         labels=["Q1\n(0–1h)", "Q2\n(2–3h)", "Q3\n(4h)", "Q4\n(>4h)"])
q_labels = [f"Q{i+1}\n({int(tmp['hrs_cca_extracurricular'].quantile(q))}-"
            f"{int(tmp['hrs_cca_extracurricular'].quantile(q+0.25))}h)"
            for i, q in enumerate([0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75])]

q_means = tmp.groupby("quartile", observed=True).apply(

ax.axhline(10, color="navy", linestyle=":", linewidth=1.2, label="International mean (10.0)")
for bar, val in zip(bars, q_means.values):

top3 = [
    ("hrs_marking_correcting",  "Marking (r = 0.19)"),
    ("hrs_other_tasks",         "Other tasks (r = 0.13)"),
    ("hrs_lesson_planning",     "Planning (r = 0.10)"),
]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))
for ax, (col, lbl) in zip(axes, top3):
    tmp = df[[col, dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
    ax.scatter(tmp[col], tmp[dv],
               s=tmp["sampling_weight"]/tmp["sampling_weight"].max()*20,
               alpha=0.3, color="steelblue", edgecolors="none")
    coeffs = np.polyfit(tmp[col], tmp[dv], 1,
                        w=tmp["sampling_weight"])
    x_line = np.linspace(tmp[col].min(), tmp[col].max(), 100)
    ax.plot(x_line, np.polyval(coeffs, x_line), color="darkred", linewidth=1.5)
    ax.set_title(lbl, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")   # <-- added
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours/week", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel("Workload stress (T4WLOADT)", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_scatter_top3.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_scatter_top3.png")
